findings.title: Customer wishes resource library had more video/imagery content (not a real ask)
findings.description: Nadia mentions her visual-thinking team might engage more with video/imagery than text articles in the resource library, but explicitly frames it as 'a want, not a need' and 'probably just my creative-brand bias talking.' Priya notes video-forward content already exists in the library but isn't surfaced by default, and offers to send a pointer to it as a follow-up favour rather than a product change.
findings.quote: our people are very visual, so I once wondered if there could be more imagery or video in the resources instead of text articles
findings.severity_reason: Explicitly disclaimed by the customer as not a real request; existing content already partially addresses it via a manual pointer.
findings.match_note: No catalogue issue for resource-library content mix; customer self-labels this as a non-ask preference, not a defect or missing capability.
